mentions.name: Event Ticketing Platform
mentions.description: A platform for selling event tickets, positioned as an alternative to Ticketmaster or weezevent. The author is building it in their free time as a side project and is also using it to gain experience with AI tools; undecided whether to turn it into a company.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a platform for selling event tickets (kind of an alternative to Ticketmaster or weezevent).
mentions.author: Manozco
